steps.text: 分析 这属于 $1^{\infty}$ 型，取对数转化为 $\frac{0}{0}$ 型。为便于求导运算，可先作倒代换。
方法1 记 $y = \left( \sin \frac{2}{x^2} + \cos \frac{1}{x} \right)^{\frac{1}{\sin^2 \left( \frac{1}{x} \right)}}$ ，令 $t = \frac{1}{x}$ ，则 $\ln y = \frac{1}{\sin^2 t} \ln (\sin 2t^2 + \cos t)$ .

\begin{array}{r l}\lim _ {x \rightarrow \infty} (\ln y)&= \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln (\sin 2 t ^ {2} + \cos t)}{\sin^ {2} t} = \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0} \frac {\ln (\sin 2 t ^ {2} + \cos t)}{t ^ {2}}\\&= \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0} \frac {4 t \cos 2 t ^ {2} - \sin t}{2 t (\sin 2 t ^ {2} + \cos t)} = \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0} \frac {4 t \cos 2 t ^ {2} - \sin t}{2 t} (\because \sin 2 t ^ {2} + \cos t \rightarrow 1)\end{array}

方法2 原式 $\lim_{t\to0}\left[1+(\sin 2t^{2}+\cos t-1)\right]^{\frac{1}{\sin^{2}t}}=e^{\lim_{t\to0}\frac{\sin 2t^{2}+\cos t-1}{\sin^{2}t}}$ .
其中

\lim _ {t \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sin 2 t ^ {2} + \cos t - 1}{\sin^ {2} t} = \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0} \frac {\sin 2 t ^ {2}}{\sin^ {2} t} - \lim _ {t \rightarrow 0} \frac {1 - \cos t}{\sin^ {2} t} = 2 - \frac {1}{2} = \frac {3}{2}.
